projects.title: Path Search on Public Transportation Graphs
bullets: Constructed graphs from public urban bus route tables using Python and NetworkX for a supervised undergraduate capstone team project.
Tested disconnected graph cases as part of the capstone team's work on path search in public transportation graphs.

projects.title: Reproducible Processing of Bibliographic Tables
bullets: Recorded software dependencies for reproducible processing of public scientific tables in a supervised undergraduate course project on bibliographic analysis.
Wrote data-schema checks using Python and pandas as an assigned contribution to the course team's public bibliographic analysis workflow.

research.title: Reproducible Public Transport Table Processing
bullets: Recorded software dependencies as a student research assistant contributing to supervised faculty research on reproducible public scientific table processing.
Reproduced summary tables from raw inputs using Python and pandas within supervised research on public transport analysis workflows.
